facts.text: Serve the mains when Smurf puts dinner on the table for her boys.
facts.why: Smurf meets Craig, Pope and Darren at a restaurant. The home dinner in the script is not Smurf serving, and she says Pope is cooking.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Smurf and her sons meet at a restaurant.

facts.text: Smurf cooks for her boys. Behave at the table.
facts.why: Smurf is the matriarch who runs the family. In the script she says Pope is cooking, so she is not shown cooking.
facts.fix: Smurf runs the family. Behave at the table.

facts.text: Come in, J. Dinner is on. Sit down and stay close to the family.
facts.why: A note in Smurf's voice. J does move in with Smurf after his mum dies, but the 'dinner is on' part has no source.
facts.fix: Come in, J. Sit down and stay close to the family.

fix_note.text: Come in, J. Sit down and stay close to the family.

facts.text: the boys on the couch with the footy on
facts.why: The script has J on the couch with the TV on and his uncles joining him, but never footy.
facts.fix: the boys on the couch, telly on, alibi set

facts.text: J's drink on the couch, TV still on.
facts.why: J says he was having a nap on the couch with the TV on. No drink is described there.
facts.fix: J's nap on the couch, TV still on.
